bullets.title: Resetting your cellular data stats on an iPhone
bullets.note: I was consuming mobile data at an unusually high rate (e.g., “You have 10% remaining for the next 10 days”), and I followed these steps to figure out what the hell was gobbling it up. Step one is resetting your cellular data stats to zero, which most of us did years ago, if ever: “To reset these statistics, go to **Settings > Cellular**, scroll to the bottom, then tap **Reset Statistics**.” Within a few hours, I knew who the offenders were and could minimize overages.

bullets.section: What I’m enjoying in the morning
bullets.title: Vashon Island Coffee Dust
bullets.note:
One of the simplest ways to reduce glucose/insulin spikes and improve health (and lose more fat) is to change how you drink your daily coffee. A lot of readers of [_The 4-Hour Body_](https://www.amazon.com/Hour-Body-Uncommon-Incredible-Superhuman/dp/030746363X/) have thanked me for the tip to use cinnamon and/or vanilla extract instead of their usual milk and sugar. Achtung! Some artificial sweeteners (sucralose, saccharin, acesulfame-K, etc.) can trigger insulin release through taste receptors or metabolic pathways, even in the absence of carbohydrates.**  
​  
​**Now, cinnamon is great, but it can lose its novelty. That’s where Vashon Coffee Dust comes in: “The Coffee Dust Flavor Expedition Kit is your all-access pass to the magical world of coffee flavoring—with zero sweeteners, preservatives, or nonsense. Inside, you’ll find 72 servings of flavor-packed goodness across all six of our fabulous blends, plus a perfectly sized spoon because you deserve precision when sprinkling joy into your coffee.” I particularly love the Healthful (cinnamon, turmeric, ginger, nutmeg, cardamom, black pepper, sea salt) and Hot Momma (Ghirardelli cocoa, cayenne, cinnamon, sea salt), but they’re all delicious.
